title: Execute anonymous Apex
description: Runs Apex code in the org with the caller permissions.

title: Call a custom Apex REST endpoint
description: Calls code deployed in the org; its effects are not known.

title: Run Apex tests
description: Runs tests, which can write data in the org.

title: Abort a bulk job
description: Stops a running job; processed rows stay changed.

title: Run a bulk ingest job
description: Inserts, updates, upserts or deletes many records from a file.

title: Post to Chatter
description: Posts a feed item visible to followers.

title: Run a composite request
description: Runs up to 25 subrequests in one call, any of which may write or delete.

title: Create a connected app
description: Registers an OAuth client with its secret.

title: Request a full data export
description: Prepares a weekly or on-demand export of all org data.

title: Describe an object
description: Fields and relationships of an sObject.

title: Send a mass email
description: Sends email to a list view or campaign members.

title: Send an email
description: Sends an email through the org.

title: Delete metadata components
description: Deletes custom objects, fields or code, with their data.

title: Deploy metadata
description: Deploys customisations (objects, code, flows) to the org.

title: Change object access in a permission set
description: Grants or removes create/read/edit/delete on an object.

title: Change record owner
description: Transfers ownership, which changes who can see the record.

title: Delete any record
description: Deletes a record of any object type.

title: Merge records
description: Merges duplicates into one master record; the others are deleted.

title: Share a record
description: Grants a user or group access to a record.

title: Restore a deleted record
description: Restores a record from the recycle bin.

title: Upsert a record by external id
description: Creates or updates a record matched on an external id.

title: Refresh a sandbox
description: Replaces a sandbox with a copy of production.

title: Revoke a session or token
description: Ends a user session or OAuth token.

title: Assign a permission set
description: Gives a user a permission set.

title: Create a user
description: Creates a login for the org.

title: Reset a user password
description: Sends a password reset to a user.

title: Revoke a permission set
description: Takes a permission set from a user.
